settings.heading: What is the Venustas Heatwave Club?
settings.body: The Venustas Heatwave Club is Venustas’s rewards program. Join the club, make purchases, and get Heatwave treats along the way.

settings.heading: How do I join the Venustas Heatwave Club?
settings.body: It’s simple! To join, create an account online, or sign in if you already have an account. By doing this, you’ll immediately become a member of the Venustas Heatwave Club. It’s FREE to join. Plus, you’ll get 100 FREE Heated Points just for joining!

settings.heading: How do I earn points?
settings.body:
You can earn points with these warm actions:

  • 1.Create an account: Starting from 100 Heated Points
  • 2.Shop Heated gear: 1 Heated Point for every $1 spent on products
  • 3.Connect with us: 50 Heated Points for following us on social
  • 4.Spread warmth: 50 Heated Points for social sharing
  • 5.Birthday toast: 100 Heated Points to celebrate your birthday (you must enter your birthday details in the panel)

settings.heading: How do I get points for my purchases?
settings.body:
You’ll get 1 point for every dollar you spend on products on Venustasofficial.com. Points are based on final dollar value. We’ll have special promotions where you’ll be able to get more points for every purchase.

*Make sure to sign in before making a purchase so you can get all your Heated Points. We can’t offer points for purchases if you haven’t logged in to your account.

settings.heading: What’s the Birthday Rewards?
settings.body:
You’ll receive additional heated points on your birthday every year. All you need to do is sign in to your account, visit the “earn points” section and enter your birthday.

Note: Your birthday must be entered and confirmed at least 30 days in advance to be rewarded.

settings.heading: How do I know my Heated Points balance?
settings.body: Once you have signed in to your account, click on the Heatwave Rewards icon on the upper right corner of your browser, you will find your point balance on the pop-up widget. You can also find your point balance on the top of your account page.

settings.heading: How do I redeem my points?
settings.body:
To redeem points, sign into your account, click on the Heatwave Rewards icon in the upper right corner of your browser.Redeem points by clicking on "Ways to redeem" and choose your favorite reward.

When you do this, you will receive a coupon code to use with your order in our store.Coupon codes can only apply on full-price items and can not be combined with other discounts.

settings.heading: What does the Heatwave Explorer, Heatwave Elite & Heatwave Expert?
settings.body:
These are member tiers that come with different member perks and benefits. Based on the total spent on https://venustas.com, you will automatically enter different tiers:

  • Heatwave Explorer from $0-$299
  • Heatwave Elite from $300-$799
  • Heatwave Expert from $800+

settings.heading: How can I get exclusive member deals?
settings.body:
Exclusive deals for members will be shown in your account page after signing in to your account.You will need to use the exclusive codes to get the deals.

If you have any concerns about the member exclusive deals, please contact us at service@venustas.com

settings.heading: What is the birthday month gift?
settings.body:
It’s the celebration for your birthday! For all Heatwave Expert members, you will receive a special birthday gift at your birthday month!

Remember to fill your birthday in your member info! Only when your birthday is filled one month in advance of your birthday, you can receive a birthday gift by the month of your birthday!

settings.heading: Can I earn points for purchases made on Amazon or other Venustas sites?
settings.body:
You will only receive heated Points for purchases made on our US website, https.//venustas.com.

Amazon purchases or purchases made in any of our other stores will not add points.
